title: Scan store says whether any folder at or below a given folder is still unlisted
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: 1. For every folder in stores stopped at many points on real temp trees, the store's answer matches a full walk of everything below that folder: missing
2. The answer relies on the shipped traversal (one writer, depth-first, each folder's children one block); a test fails if that traversal is changed to a queue or made parallel: missing
3. Answering for every row of an open 100k-child folder fits inside the 0.5 s open budget (timing test on a 5M-entry synthetic store stopped late, with a 100k-child folder): missing
4. A scan that runs to the end reports nothing unlisted below any folder (core test on completed scans of real temp trees): missing
5. The answer adds no per-entry storage; a 5M-entry store stopped late stays within the 800 MiB store bound (memory test at 5M entries in U-201's shape): missing

Derived (from 'the store can say, for any folder'): a public read on ScanStore in Core, exact on the same terms as NotListed (between appends on the writing thread, and after Scan has returned): missing

Derived (from the SC-367 merge note): SL-111's design records that the answer holds only while the traversal stays depth-first, and that a Kind-bit marker would need masking across the seven Kind reads: missing
The name NotListedAtOrBelow, against AnyNotListedAtOrBelow or SubtreeUnfinished. Uncontested; the reviewer may prefer another.
Placement in ScanStore.cs beside NotListed, rather than in ScanStore.Rollup.cs. The rationale is Rollup.cs's 'never walks below' header, but it is a layering call.
A new NotListedBelowTests.cs that reaches into NotListedTests' now-internal sweep helpers, against putting the new Theories inside NotListedTests (or a shared fixture class).
Self-inclusive 'at or below', against U-204's strict-descendant reading. This is a semantic choice with no consumer yet.
A Kind-byte architecture rule as a tripwire for a future Kind-bit marker. A reviewer may judge it premature, since U-201 shows masking makes the marker valid.
